key.name: move-modifiers
key.summary: Modifiers that move the window under the pointer
key.description: Any of: shift, control, alt, super. The combination must match exactly. An empty list disables moving.

key.name: resize-modifiers
key.summary: Modifiers that resize the window under the pointer
key.description: Any of: shift, control, alt, super. The combination must match exactly. An empty list disables resizing.

key.name: raise-window
key.summary: Raise the window when it starts being moved or resized

key.name: resize-nearest-corner
key.summary: Resize from the corner nearest the pointer
key.description: When false, resizing always moves the bottom-right corner.

key.name: snap-threshold
key.description: Window edges within this distance of a screen edge (or another window's edge) snap to it. 0 disables snapping. Ignored while the grid is enabled.

key.name: snap-to-windows
key.summary: Also snap to the edges of other windows

key.name: grid-enabled
key.summary: Snap window edges to a grid

key.name: grid-columns
key.summary: Number of grid columns per monitor

key.name: grid-rows
key.summary: Number of grid rows per monitor

key.name: show-grid
key.summary: Show the grid while moving or resizing

key.name: dim-windows
key.summary: Dim other windows while moving or resizing with the grid
